PO.core_objective: Process employee payroll, resident-tax, and social-insurance cases, including allowance changes and leave requests with supporting documentation.

BATCH.core_objective: Review payroll master records and reconcile onboarding records, documenting processing decisions, results, and exceptions.

SOCIAL.core_objective: Assess and process social-insurance cases and employee requests while recording processing and response statuses.

RESIDENT.core_objective: Review resident-tax records and complete company-specific processing details for employee cases.

PAYROLL.core_objective: Implement and document payroll changes, including salary increases, allowance adjustments, and dependent deductions.

ONBOARDING.core_objective: Reconcile onboarding transfer amounts and employee records, documenting results and discrepancies.
